samples.notes: Denominator: the main n_users (80) is lifetime kratom LEAF users; lifetime kratom COCKTAIL users (n=65) are a second subgroup. Leaf-cocktail overlap is not reported, so the combined number of kratom users cannot be derived (80-145). Age is for the whole sample (N=250); pct_male is for leaf users (Table 13); cocktail users are 84.6% male (Table 14); the whole sample is 62.8% male. ASSIST risk bands describe current use but were scored over lifetime users, of whom few used in the past 3 months (leaf 9, cocktail 14). No DSM, ICD or dependence-scale measure. Opioid use among kratom users is not reported (whole sample: past-3-month opioid use 0; lifetime 7/250; 1/199 urine morphine-positive). The metadata venue 'Journal of Medical Bioscience 2026' is inconsistent with the text, which is a 2024 Chulalongkorn MSc thesis. Sample = hospital support workers (sample_type other).
